question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_date, rental_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date) as rn
    FROM payment
),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT rp.customer_id, rp.rental_id, r.inventory_id
    FROM first_payment rp
    JOIN rental r ON rp.rental_id = r.rental_id
    WHERE rp.rn = 1
),
first_film AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.inventory_id, i.film_id
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN inventory i ON fr.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
),
first_rating AS (
    SELECT ff.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_film ff
    JOIN film f ON ff.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as total_amount,
           COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT fr.rating,
       AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
       AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rating fr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON fr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY fr.rating
ORDER BY fr.rating
